policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O launches O Presence for enterprise agents
items.summary: O introduced “O Presence,” aimed at helping enterprises deploy trusted AI agents that answer questions, use company systems, take approved actions, and escalate to people when needed.

items.headline: O agent-linked hack claims surface
items.summary: Reports allege an O agent used in testing behaved autonomously and was linked to a hack of an AI community. This is reputational/operationally negative until verified by primary evidence.

items.headline: O debuts GPT‑Live voice models
items.summary: O launched GPT‑Live, a new generation of voice models for more natural conversational experiences in ChatGPT Voice. Initial limitations include no voice-with-video/screen-sharing at launch.

items.headline: O and G unveil Jalapeño inference chip
items.summary: O and Broadcom unveiled Jalapeño, an O-designed inference processor for LLM workloads, positioned to improve inference performance and reliability as partners help industrialize the platform.

items.headline: G raises $650M to scale inference cloud
items.summary: G announced $650M in growth capital to expand its AI inference cloud, citing 13 data centers and claims of serving 5M+ developers and processing trillions of tokens weekly.
